title: Nvidia reports Q1 net income up 211% YoY to $58.3B, beating analyst estimates of $42.9B, and raises Q2 revenue forecast to $91B (Robbie Whelan/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Robbie Whelan / Wall Street Journal: Nvidia reports Q1 net income up 211% YoY to $58.3B, beating analyst estimates of $42.9B, and raises Q2 revenue forecast to $91B — Astronomical rise in AI agents and demand for data-center computing lift chipmaker to another record quarter — Chip giant Nvidia reported record sales and income Wednesday …
contentText:
Robbie Whelan / Wall Street Journal :

Nvidia reports Q1 net income up 211% YoY to $58.3B, beating analyst estimates of $42.9B, and raises Q2 revenue forecast to $91B   —  Astronomical rise in AI agents and demand for data-center computing lift chipmaker to another record quarter  —  Chip giant Nvidia reported record sales and income Wednesday …
